title: Intervention Effectiveness v0.2: confidence is a separate gate
summary: Effectiveness measures observed association between intervention-applied and eligible-not-applied journeys. v0.2 requires denominator sufficiency, effect materiality and, by default, non-overlapping 95% Wilson intervals before directional PROMISING/ADVERSE labels are emitted.
invariants: The denominator is intervention-eligible journeys, not all customers.
Primary and guardrail outcomes stay separate; no one-metric optimisation.
Overlapping confidence intervals produce NO_CLEAR_ASSOCIATION by default even when the point estimate looks material.
The confidence rule is configurable and preserved in canonical reasoning material.
RANDOMIZED is study-design provenance and never self-promotes causal authority.
Current, previous and long-baseline studies remain separate.

provenance.claim: Eligibility denominator, guardrails, confidence gate and NO_CLEAR_ASSOCIATION on overlap.
Association-only causal boundary and configured confidence-gate pipeline.
